title: Roll out strict non-bypassable base-update guards
goal: Inventory every repository and base branch eligible for direct Captain merge and establish an active GitHub ruleset with nonempty strict required status checks that the current merge actor cannot bypass; preserve stronger existing protections and keep Captain fail-closed where the contract cannot be met.

approval.note: Mutate repository ruleset settings only with operator authority after an exact inventory and per-repository effect plan. Organization-level discovery may run under service.github_actions, but before any repository-scoped rules read or mutation the run must atomically expand its claim to the exact repo.* resource in write mode and prove live ownership. Do not weaken existing checks, add bypass actors, change visibility, modify code, or assume that one repository policy safely generalizes to another.

acceptance.assertion: A bounded inventory identifies every repository and exact default or merge-target branch that may be dispatched through Captain, plus its active rules, required checks, enforcement state, current-user bypass state and bypass actors; omissions and inaccessible repositories are explicit.

Organization-level repository discovery is the only operation allowed under the service claim alone. Before reading branch-protection or ruleset state for a concrete repository, and before every mutation, the run atomically expands its claim to that exact repo.* resource in write mode, proves the lease is live and retains it through repository readback; missing resource mappings or conflicting claims fail closed without settings effects.
Each enabled direct-Captain target has at least one active applying ruleset with a nonempty required-status-check rule and strict_required_status_checks_policy=true.

For the current Captain GitHub actor, current_user_can_bypass is never and no bypass actor can authorize the direct merge path; stronger existing review, signed-commit, deployment or branch restrictions remain intact.
Every ruleset mutation is repository-, branch-, old-state- and new-state-bound with preflight and readback; no repository visibility, code, branch, workflow or unrelated setting changes.

Repositories that cannot or should not satisfy the strict ruleset contract remain fail-closed for direct Captain dispatch and receive a reviewed alternative merge procedure instead of a bypass or weakened check.

The deployed T057 guard accepts each protected target from fresh paginated rules and detail reads and rejects intentionally unprotected or bypassable fixtures; policy drift between reads fails closed.
The final receipt records changed, already-compliant, blocked and excluded repositories separately and does not reinterpret historical merges as compliant.

metadata.trigger: T057 intentionally blocks repositories without a strict non-bypassable stale-base barrier; live smoke confirmed heimgewebe/audio currently lacks such a rule.
metadata.risk: Cross-repository settings changes can block merges or weaken protection if applied generically or concurrently with repository work; execution must be per-repository, exact-claim-bound and fail closed.
does_not_establish: that every repository needs identical checks
that GitHub exposes exact base-ref compare-and-swap

claim_expansion_contract.discovery_scope: Organization-level repository enumeration only; no repository-specific protection or ruleset endpoint may be read under the service claim alone.
claim_expansion_contract.required_before_repository_read: Atomically claim-expand the active Bureau run with a write claim for the exact mapped repo.* resource before the first repository-scoped branch-protection or ruleset read.
claim_expansion_contract.required_before_mutation: Revalidate ownership of the exact repo.* write claim immediately before any GitHub settings mutation and retain it through post-effect readback.
claim_expansion_contract.missing_mapping: Do not read or mutate settings; register or repair the canonical repository resource first.
claim_expansion_contract.conflict: Fail closed and leave settings unchanged; never override, expire or release a foreign claim.
claim_expansion_contract.release: Release only through normal terminal lifecycle after the repository-specific post-effect readback or an unambiguous no-effect outcome.

priority_reconciliation.reason: Cross-repository GitHub ruleset mutation has high blast radius. Keep the complete task, but schedule it after bounded inventory and pilot evidence instead of ahead of ready product work.
does_not_establish: permission to bypass dependencies or live gates
